name: Ganti Password Mobile

endpoints.description: Mengubah password akun user mobile yang sedang login (via Sanctum token) setelah verifikasi password lama

error_codes.condition: field wajib kosong, atau new_password tidak memenuhi format min 6 karakter alfanumerik+simbol
old_password tidak cocok dengan password user saat ini

business_logic: 1. Validate request body (semua field wajib) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Validate format new_password (min 6 karakter, alfanumerik+simbol) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. Validate new_password_confirmation cocok dengan new_password → if mismatch: return 422 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH
4. Verifikasi old_password terhadap hash password user saat ini → if salah: return 422 OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT

edge_case_handling.handling: Client-side check sebelum submit — blokir aksi, tampilkan pesan koneksi internet diperlukan, tidak memanggil API

business_rules_applied: Password baru minimal 6 karakter, case-sensitive, alfanumerik+simbol

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when a required field is missing or empty
unit_test_cases.given: request body has old_password, new_password, or new_password_confirmation missing/empty

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when new_password does not meet format (min 6 chars, alphanumeric+symbol)
unit_test_cases.given: new_password = '12345' (does not satisfy min length / alphanumeric+symbol rule)

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH when new_password_confirmation does not match new_password
returns 422 OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT when old_password does not match the authenticated user's current password hash
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo password hash comparison for old_password returns false for the current authenticated user
unit_test_cases.expect: return 422 with error_code OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT; user.password_hash remains unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: authenticated user exists, old_password matches current hash, new_password meets format rules, new_password_confirmation matches new_password
unit_test_cases.expect: update user.password_hash with hash of new_password and return 200 with success message

implementation_notes: Aksi ini membutuhkan koneksi internet aktif; deteksi tidak ada koneksi dilakukan client-side sebelum submit ke API (aksi ditunda, tidak memanggil endpoint)
Sesi invalidate setelah ganti password berhasil belum diputuskan (open question, sama seperti versi web)

component_test.action: fill old password, new password, and confirmation fields with valid values, click Simpan button
component_test.assert: form submits successfully, success confirmation message shown, form reset/closed

browser_test.action: navigate to Ganti Password menu, fill old password, new password and confirmation fields with valid values, tap Simpan
browser_test.assert: success confirmation message displayed, account password updated

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Mobile — Tidak Ada Koneksi Internet

component_test.action: fill form with valid values, click Simpan while device network is offline (simulate no connectivity)
component_test.assert: form blocks submission, displays message that internet connection is required, no API call is made

browser_test.action: fill Ganti Password form with valid values, tap Simpan while device has no internet connection
browser_test.assert: message indicating internet connection required is displayed, password change action is deferred/blocked, no network request is sent

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Mobile — Password Lama Salah

component_test.action: fill incorrect old password along with valid new password and confirmation, click Simpan
component_test.assert: error message displayed indicating old password is incorrect, password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: enter incorrect old password with valid new password and confirmation, tap Simpan
browser_test.assert: error message shown for incorrect old password, account password remains unchanged

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Mobile — Password Baru Tidak Memenuhi Format

component_test.action: fill new password that does not meet format rules (fewer than 6 chars or missing alphanumeric+symbol mix), click Simpan
component_test.assert: validation error message displayed for password format, password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: enter new password not meeting format requirements (min 6 chars, alphanumeric+symbol), tap Simpan
browser_test.assert: format validation error message displayed, account password remains unchanged

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Mobile — Konfirmasi Tidak Cocok

component_test.action: fill new password and confirmation fields with mismatching values, click Simpan
component_test.assert: error message displayed indicating confirmation mismatch, password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: enter new password and confirmation that do not match, tap Simpan
browser_test.assert: confirmation mismatch error message displayed, account password remains unchanged
